_comment: Template for the <app_name>-secrets container (create_app_secret = true). Copy this file to a GITIGNORED location (e.g. secrets/<app_name>.json), replace every value, and upload it out-of-band (never commit real values). Keys are app-defined — add/remove to match what your task definition's `secrets` entries read via valueFrom = "<app_secrets_arn>:<key>::". Delete this _comment key before uploading.
